name: Empower Fiend
body:
Your touch of evil is a powerful restorative to all manner of diabolical creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, touch of corruption class feature

Benefit(s): You can use your touch of corruption to heal evil outsiders. If the creature is healed by negative energy, you can heal it as though it were undead. Otherwise, you grant temporary hit points which can’t take the creature above its maximum, and persist for up to 1 hour. This temporary healing stacks with itself.
